business: India's largest FMCG company serving 9 of 10 households with 50 brands across 15 categories: home care, beauty & wellbeing, personal care, foods. Turnover ₹63,763 Cr.

segments.name: Home Care
segments.comment: Fabric wash, household care, premium liquids

revenue_mix: Pan-India reach across 9 Mn+ outlets. 50 brands spanning 15 FMCG categories: home care, beauty, personal care, foods, beverages, nutrition.
strategy: Radical consumer segmentation across democratisers, power spenders, premiumisers
Create modern premium science-backed brands with digital-first launches
Accelerate footprint in general trade and channels of future
Double-down on fewer bigger bets in high-growth spaces
Enable through AI, cost efficiency, sustainability, talent capability
outlook: FY2026 delivered 5% growth, 4% UVG, 23.6% EBITDA margin with sequential acceleration. Management confident in volume-led growth despite near-term macro challenges.
capex_plans: ₹2,000 Cr to expand manufacturing in premium Beauty & Wellbeing and Home Care liquids. 45 MW off-site solar park commissioned.
risks: Commodity volatility and currency headwinds pressure margins
Geopolitical tensions and rapid technological disruption
Consumer spending vulnerability to macro headwinds
Quick commerce and e-commerce channel disruption
flags: Ice Cream business demerger reported as Discontinued Operations. Consolidated basis reporting. Walker Chandiok & Co LLP (auditors), B S R & Co. LLP (sustainability assurance).
